channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 25
item.description:
73 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Flashlight toggles with right‑click like a torch, press F removed; session modal scrolling fixed; store featured tiles now clickable.

Combat & Weapon Balance

  • Radwater now deals significant damage to full kits with a new scaling system that reduces rad amounts via scaled protection.
  • Semi‑automatic pistol damage now falls off more sharply at range and its craft cost increased.
  • HAB armour colliders are correctly set up on client and server, with a proper collision mesh for the frame, ensuring reliable removal.
  • Weapon spawn distribution adjusted: SMG bodies appear more often while Rifle bodies are less common, improving mid‑game load‑out variety.

Comfort

  • Bear rugs and regular rugs now provide full (100%) comfort within 2 m and 1 m respectively, with gradual falloff, fixing the previous low solo comfort.

Vehicles

  • Modular car wheels corrected: left wheels use the proper model, eliminating mirrored wheels and flipped normals.
  • Vehicle handling refined – reduced body roll, prevented spin‑outs, and smoothed steering for stable high‑speed drifting.

Animals & Livestock

  • Rabbit assets (animation, model, prefabs) added and naming standardized.
  • SellAnimals and AnimalSalePreview panels introduced, letting players view nearby sellable animals and see expected rewards.
  • Basic squirrel critter added for wildlife interactions.

Events & Performance

  • SteamFriendsList.Refresh optimized to remove large lag spikes when authorizing friends to turrets and other objects.
  • Hackable crates now have correct flags and visuals; puzzle‑reset alerts are skipped after forced resets.
  • Cargo ship event now persists crate locations and loot round progress across server restarts, preventing despawn and overlapping spawns.

UI Improvements

  • Flashlight toggles with right‑click like a torch, press F removed; session modal scrolling fixed; store featured tiles now clickable.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 24
item.description:
68 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Medkits now reduce radiation by 20, and longsword swings have a larger 0.4 radius with a faster 1.5‑second delay for more accurate attacks.
  • SAM sites fire proximity‑fuse missiles at drones, target 2.25× faster, can destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air, and a new setting lets servers adjust the drone detonation distance.
  • Homing launchers now show a “Keep on target” label and their lock‑on timer is 30 % shorter.
